name: Absalom
bio: Absalom was David's third son, born at Hebron to Maacah, daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur (2 Samuel 3:3). His later vengeance against his brother Amnon on behalf of his sister Tamar, his rebellion against his father David, and his eventual death at the hands of Joab form one of the central narratives of the second half of 2 Samuel, told in detail in chapters 13-18.
